name: Bjorn Stromberg
bio:
Bjorn's journey in motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with his father's old Volvo in their garage outside Gothenburg. This early exposure sparked a lifelong fascination with the intricacies of mechanical engineering. After earning a degree in engineering, he initially worked in the automotive industry before transitioning to motorsport, drawn by the intense pressure and pursuit of perfection. His meticulous approach to quality control is well-known, ensuring every component leaving his station meets the highest standards.

He joined PEX Motorsport a decade ago and has been instrumental in maintaining the team's reliability. Bjorn believes in rigorous testing and data analysis, relying on evidence rather than gut feelings. He is not afraid to challenge engineering decisions and always prioritizes safety and performance. His pragmatic approach, combined with a deep understanding of mechanical systems, makes him a valuable asset to the team.

Bjorn is particularly known for his innovative approach to problem-solving. Despite his age, he is constantly reading and learning about new materials and manufacturing techniques, always searching for ways to improve the team's performance. He's always willing to help younger members of the team, and his commitment to excellence has made him a highly respected figure within PEX Motorsport.
